content.text:
The public site's background music player is the `BackgroundMusicPlayer` component in `components/public/background-music-player.tsx`. It's declared at line 21 and is also the default export. The file's header calls it an "Ambient storefront background music player".

- **Where it's mounted:** `app/(public)/layout.tsx` imports it (line 2) and renders it (line 12), so it appears on every public route.
- **Config source:** it fetches `/api/public/music-config`, which reads the setting through `SettingsService.getSetting()`. I got that from `llms-full.txt`, not from the component or route code.
- **Admin side:**
  - The settings UI is in `app/admin/settings/page.tsx`, under "Store Experience → Background Music" (around line 508).
  - The save endpoint is `app/api/admin/settings/music/route.ts`.
- **Default behavior:** `test/obsidian-polish.test.ts` (line 77) expects it to render nothing when music is unconfigured or disabled.
- **Other mention:** `components/public/PublicFooter.tsx` (line 221) has a comment about background music, which may be a footer control. I didn't open it.

The code-atlas tool (`fullstack_find`) was denied permission, so I used Grep instead. I didn't open the component file itself.
